reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 书店里的试读本和免费单页

materials.title: Bookshop Signs 038A
materials.text: The bookshop has a reading copy marked "Please leave here." New books are on the sale shelf. Event leaflets by the door are free. Collect reserved books at the desk with your order card. Ask staff before opening a wrapped book.

questions.prompt: A friend wants to buy the reading copy. Say: ____
options: Choose a new copy from the sale shelf.
Put your order card inside the reading copy.
questions.explanation: B试读本留店，购买取销售架新本；A带走违反标记；C塞卡不完成购买选择。

questions.prompt: A friend asks how much the event leaflet costs. Say: ____
options: Ask where the reading table is.
The leaflets by the door are free.
questions.explanation: C单页免费直接答收费否；A类型错，B读桌位置不答费用。

questions.prompt: A reserved book is waiting for your family. Say: ____
options: Show the order card at the desk.
questions.explanation: C预约取件凭订单卡；A乱拆、B代拿试读本不合领取程序。

questions.prompt: A friend starts opening a wrapped book. Say: ____
options: Put your coat near the door.
questions.explanation: A拆封前先问员工；B读单页、C放衣不构成许可。

questions.prompt: A new sale copy is left on the reading table by mistake. Say: ____
options: Put it back on the sale shelf.
Hide it in a leaflet pile.
questions.explanation: B销售新本回销售架；A擅标免费、C藏单页中都混用途。

units.title: 学校疏散练习的集合要求

materials.title: School Practice Alarm 038A
materials.text: This is a school practice. Leave bags in the classroom. Walk with the class and follow the teacher. Use the marked stairs, not the lift. At the meeting place, wait until the teacher finishes checking the class. Tell the teacher if someone is missing.

questions.prompt: A friend goes back for a schoolbag during the practice. Say: ____
options: Leave the bag in class and stay with us.
questions.explanation: A练习留包并跟队；B换包、C午饭不符合当前流程。

questions.prompt: A friend starts running away from the class. Say: ____
options: Run to a different meeting place.
Walk with the class and follow the teacher.
questions.explanation: C跟班步行；A离队、B电梯违明示路线。

questions.prompt: A friend walks towards the lift. Say: ____
options: Put your bag beside the lift.
questions.explanation: B规定标记楼梯非电梯；A等梯、C放包不纠路线。

questions.prompt: The class is still being counted. A friend wants to leave the meeting place. Say: ____
options: Wait until the teacher finishes the check.
questions.explanation: C清点完前留集合地；A离开、B问书不满足核齐条件。

questions.prompt: You cannot see a classmate at the meeting point. Say: ____
options: Tell the teacher that someone seems to be missing.
Leave alone to search the building.
questions.explanation: A按明示要求报告；B独自返楼、C隐不报不合程序。

units.title: 操场活动里的十段完整语境

materials.title: Playground Help Ten Choices 038A
materials.text: Choose the correct word or reply for each complete playground situation.

questions.prompt: The children ____ drawing a long road with chalk now.
questions.explanation: A children复数are构成进行；B单三、C I配am不合。

questions.prompt: My brother usually ____ the chalk box after class.
questions.explanation: B brother单三且usually习惯用returns；A原形不合，C分词缺be。

questions.prompt: These mats belong to us. They are ____.
questions.explanation: C ours独立物主表语；A our需名词，B us宾格非所有。

questions.prompt: The surface is wet. We ____ use the running area yet.
questions.explanation: C cannot与yet及湿面不可用情境一致；A/B be后不接use原形。

questions.prompt: A friend asks, "May I help with the cards?" You welcome the help. Say: ____
options: Yes, please. You can sort these.
The gate is near the tree.
The cards are made of paper.
questions.explanation: A接受并给具体分工；B门位、C纸材不回应加入帮忙。

questions.prompt: Do we need a clean cloth? Yes, we ____.
questions.explanation: B Do问we配do答；A are不答need助动词问，C does不配we。

questions.prompt: Please ____ space for the child carrying the wide model.
questions.explanation: A祈使leave原形；B单三、C分词不成指令。

questions.prompt: A sign says the path must stay clear. Which reply helps a friend with a bag there?
options: Please move your bag off the path.
questions.explanation: C挪包直接清路；A喜好、B天气不处理阻道。

questions.prompt: There are two small ____ to collect the paper pieces.
questions.explanation: B two要求boxes标准复数；A单数、C错拼。

questions.prompt: You did not hear the next step. What do you ask?
options: Could you repeat the next step, please?
questions.explanation: C求重说缺听步骤；A餐、B树高不澄清活动说明。

units.title: 练习一个新单词的完整对话

materials.title: New Word Practice Order 038A
materials.text:
Read and order the written dialogue. No recording is needed. The first line is fixed: 1. I cannot read this new word.
A. Garden. Is that right?
B. Yes, please. Then I can try.
C. Yes, well done.
D. Shall I say it slowly for you?
E. Garden. Now you try.
Choose each line’s position from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: D第5步跟读Garden并问对否，接Now you try；A第2步先提慢念，B第3步接受，C第4步示范，E第6步评价。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: B第3步Yes接受慢念帮助；A第2步先提帮助，C第4步示范，D第5步跟读，E第6步确认。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: E第6步Yes回答Is that right并鼓励；A/B/C/D前四位置是提议、接受、示范和跟读，尚未到评价。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: A第2步针对不会读提出慢念；B第3步接受，C第4步示范，D第5步试读，E第6步确认。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: C第4步示范后请对方试；A第2步应先提议，B第3步接受，D第5步才试，E第6步确认。

units.title: 新邻居办事计划里的五个地点

materials.title: New Neighbour Place Bank 038A
materials.text:
Read the complete weekly plan and use each place once. Bank: A. station B. park C. clinic D. bakery E. library
Nora helps a new neighbour plan the week. For a health appointment, they visit the ____1____, where a doctor sees patients. To borrow a storybook, they go to the ____2____. Fresh bread is on their list for the ____3____. A walk among grass and trees takes them to the ____4____. For the train journey at the end of the week, they wait at the ____5____.

questions.prompt: Which place completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: C clinic诊所见医生病人；A车站、B公园、D面包房、E图书馆不是此医疗预约场所。

questions.prompt: Which place completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: E library借故事书；A候车、B散步、C看病、D买面包的功能均不对应借书。

questions.prompt: Which place completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: D bakery供应新鲜面包；A车站、B公园、C诊所、E图书馆不以制售面包为所需功能。

questions.prompt: Which place completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B park草树间散步；A车站、C诊所、D面包房、E图书馆不是本句绿地目的地。

questions.prompt: Which place completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A station候乘火车；B公园、C诊所、D面包房、E图书馆均非火车乘降站。

units.title: 报名郊游时的完整问答

materials.title: Outing Booking Conversation 038A
materials.text:
Complete the written conversation using each reply once.
A. At the north gate near the bus area.
B. After the leader checks our booking cards.
C. Because the bus cannot turn in the narrow lane.
D. Yes, if you bring the signed form.
E. A water bottle and a sunhat.

Pupil: May I join Saturday’s outing?
Helper: ____1____
Pupil: What should I bring for myself?
Helper: ____2____
Pupil: Where do we meet?
Helper: ____3____
Pupil: Why are we not using the little side entrance?
Helper: ____4____
Pupil: When may we get on the bus?
Helper: ____5____

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 1?
options: At the north gate near the bus area.
After the leader checks our booking cards.
Because the bus cannot turn in the narrow lane.
Yes, if you bring the signed form.
A water bottle and a sunhat.
questions.explanation: D带签字表才可参加，答许可条件；A集合处、B上车时、C转弯原因、E物品不答加入条件。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 2?
options: At the north gate near the bus area.
After the leader checks our booking cards.
Because the bus cannot turn in the narrow lane.
Yes, if you bring the signed form.
A water bottle and a sunhat.
questions.explanation: E水瓶帽子答个人带物；A地点、B时机、C原因、D许可不列用品。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 3?
options: At the north gate near the bus area.
After the leader checks our booking cards.
Because the bus cannot turn in the narrow lane.
Yes, if you bring the signed form.
A water bottle and a sunhat.
questions.explanation: A北门车区答集合处；B时机、C原因、D许可、E用品不答Where。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 4?
options: At the north gate near the bus area.
After the leader checks our booking cards.
Because the bus cannot turn in the narrow lane.
Yes, if you bring the signed form.
A water bottle and a sunhat.
questions.explanation: C车不能窄道转弯解释不用侧口；A北门点、B核卡时、D报名条件、E用品不说明原因。

questions.prompt: Which reply completes gap 5?
options: At the north gate near the bus area.
After the leader checks our booking cards.
Because the bus cannot turn in the narrow lane.
Yes, if you bring the signed form.
A water bottle and a sunhat.
questions.explanation: B领队核卡后答上车时机；A地点、C原因、D报名表条件、E用品不答When。

units.title: 不用说话表演泡茶

materials.title: Mime Tea Eight Cloze 038A
materials.text:
Read the complete story and choose a word for every numbered gap.
At the class party, we played a guessing game without ____1____. Jules and I wanted to show making tea. He ____2____ from an imaginary pot, but some pupils thought he was ____3____ a plant. The movements looked similar. I added the action of lifting a cup to ____4____ from it. We performed the whole sequence again ____5____ agreeing on the order of the actions. The extra clue made our meaning ____6____. This time, the audience ____7____ tea correctly. We ____8____ at each other and sat down. Now we could tell the story in words as well as movements.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A words与后文用动作及最后能说话对照；B梯、C窗不是所禁表达方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B poured想象茶壶倒液动作；A睡、C印不对壶动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B倒壶动作像浇植物；A借植物、C读植物不解释所述相似动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: C举杯到口喝drink显示茶；A折、B数不表现举杯饮用。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A先约动作序再重演，after agreeing；B里面、C下面不表先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C补线索后表达更清楚clearer；A睡、B木制不表意思易懂。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: B audience guessed识猜游戏答案；A煮、C借不对猜活动。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: A成功猜出后互相smiled，符合收尾情绪动作；B种、C称不与at each other表所述回应。

units.title: 读书社三张推荐卡

materials.title: Book Recommendation Cards 038A
materials.text:
Book-club recommendation cards
Finn: I chose "Moonfield Race," a story about two siblings building a model boat for a contest. I like quick chapters and characters solving problems together.
Nala: I chose "Window Poems," a collection of short poems about everyday weather. I enjoy reading one poem before bed. It is not one long story with a single plot.
Uri: I chose "Pocket Machines," a guide to simple moving paper models. It includes diagrams and project notes. I like making things and will ask an adult about any step that needs extra help.
At the meeting, each member explains a different reading goal. Use the information in these cards to answer the questions.

questions.prompt: Finn’s recommendation includes siblings working on a model-boat contest.
questions.explanation: A正确：Finn卡明说两手足造模型船参赛；B否认故事内容。

questions.prompt: Nala chose one continuous adventure story with a single plot.
questions.explanation: B正确：短诗集且not one long story；A把诗集改成长冒险。

questions.prompt: All three members recommend the same kind of text for the same reason.
questions.explanation: B正确：故事、诗、制作指南及目标各异；A忽略卡间差别。

questions.prompt: Uri’s book suits an interest in making paper models.
questions.explanation: A正确：moving paper models指南且Uri爱制作；B否认兴趣与书的对应。

questions.prompt: The meeting gives room for different reading goals.
questions.explanation: A正确：each explains different goal；B否认结构安排。

units.title: 时钟展与手工记录的词形

materials.title: Clock Exhibition Forms 038A
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last Sunday, we ____1____ (spend) an hour at the small clock exhibition.
2. The display included two pocket ____2____ (watch) from the old workshop.
3. The back room is ____3____ (dark) than the sunlit room at the front.
4. Look! The adult helper is ____4____ (cut) thick card while the pupils watch.
5. She closed the door ____5____ (soft; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) during the short talk.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use SPEND.
questions.explanation: 接受spent：Last Sunday过去，spend不规则；spend原形、spended错、spending分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use WATCH.
questions.explanation: 接受watches：two明确手表复数，watch加es；watch单数、watchs错、watcheses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use DARK.
questions.explanation: 接受darker：is与than明确亮暗比较；dark原级、darkest最高级、darkness名词不作比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use CUT.
questions.explanation: 接受cutting：is进行，cut双写t；cut原形、cuting错拼、cuts单三不合正在裁卡。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from SOFT.
questions.explanation: 接受softly：本空明示SOFT常规-ly副词；soft、softer、softness不满足本空形态约束，不概括其他英语语境合法性，未列复核。

units.title: 语言伙伴练习时的具体问法

materials.title: Language Partner Functions 038A
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves each learner’s purpose. Other options are plausible conversation questions with different goals.

questions.prompt: You are meeting a new partner and want to use the name they prefer. What should you ask?
options: What name would you like me to use?
questions.explanation: C询本人偏好称呼；A科目、B放学时不确定应怎样称呼。

questions.prompt: A partner is not ready to share a personal story, and you want to offer a choice. What should you say?
options: Could you speak for ten more minutes?
It is fine to pass or choose a different topic. Which would you prefer?
questions.explanation: B提供跳过或换题选择，尊重未准备状态；A延长讲话施压，C颜色不提供所需选项。

questions.prompt: You have said a new word and want specific pronunciation feedback. What should you ask?
options: Which sound should I practise to make that word clearer?
questions.explanation: A问具体哪音需练，针对反馈；B借课表、C教室不评价刚说的词。

questions.prompt: A correction gives a new word, but you need to understand its meaning here. What should you ask?
options: What does that word mean in this sentence?
When will the group meet again?
questions.explanation: A询该句词义；B纸、C下次会时不解释替词意思。

questions.prompt: Two members have spoken a lot, and you want to invite quieter members without forcing them. What should you say?
options: Can we finish before anyone else speaks?
Would anyone who has not spoken like a turn? Passing is fine too.
questions.explanation: C温和邀请未发言者并准跳过；A直接结束不给机会，B字典不分配发言。

units.title: 出门旅行前把需要问清楚

materials.title: Holiday Packing Questions 038B
materials.text: Choose the question that meets each child’s exact packing or travel-preparation need.

questions.prompt: Your borrowed library book is due before the trip ends. You want to return it before leaving. Ask Dad: ____
options: Can we stop at the library before we go?
questions.explanation: B出发前安排还书直接满足到期需求；A帽、C买玩具不解决借期。

questions.prompt: You want your night clothes easy to find when you arrive late. Ask: ____
options: May I leave them at home?
May I put my night clothes near the top?
questions.explanation: C为晚到易取把睡衣近顶，明确功能目的；A留家反需求，B车次不安排取物。

questions.prompt: You do not know if the trip includes a swimming pool. You need to decide about swimming things. Ask: ____
options: Will we use a swimming pool on this trip?
questions.explanation: A询泳池计划决定装备；B箱价、C书店不提供所需行程信息。

questions.prompt: Your toy will not fit inside, and you want permission to carry it separately. Ask: ____
options: May I carry this small toy in my hand?
Can we make the trip longer?
questions.explanation: A请求分开手持玩具，解决箱内装不下的具体需要；B延长行程、C天气板新旧不确定携带方式。

questions.prompt: You cannot find the family’s ticket folder. You need its location. Ask: ____
questions.explanation: C问票夹所在；A餐时、B衣服不找票夹。

units.title: 合影时礼貌地把需要说出来

materials.title: Family Camera Speaking 038B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that fits each stated need while taking family photographs.

questions.prompt: You want permission before taking a person’s photograph. Ask: ____
options: May I look at your camera?
questions.explanation: C询拍摄本人许可；A看相机、B相册位置不是拍人的同意。

questions.prompt: You want a person to stop moving for a moment. Say: ____
options: Could you stand still for a moment?
Could you choose a different coat?
Could you show me yesterday’s photo?
questions.explanation: A礼貌请求暂静止；B换衣、C旧照片不实现当前站稳。

questions.prompt: You want the family to stand closer together. Say: ____
options: Could we look at the album?
Could you stand a little closer together?
Could you put the camera away?
questions.explanation: B直接请求缩小站位距离；A看册、C收机不调整合影位置。

questions.prompt: You want to be in the picture too and need an adult helper to take it. Ask: ____
options: Could you take a photograph of all of us?
Where should I leave my coat?
questions.explanation: B请成人拍全家包含自己；A移椅、C放衣不解决摄影者需入镜。

questions.prompt: You have finished with a borrowed camera and need its return place. Ask: ____
options: Who is in the next photograph?
Where should I return this camera?
questions.explanation: C问借机归处；A看图、B下张人物不完成归还。

units.title: 在朋友家做客的十段完整句子

materials.title: Staying With Friends Ten Choices 038B
materials.text: Choose the best word or reply for every full visiting-friends situation.

questions.prompt: The two sisters ____ preparing a small game for us.
questions.explanation: B two sisters复数are进行；A单三、C I配am不合。

questions.prompt: This cup belongs to me. It is ____.
questions.explanation: A mine独立物主表语；B my需名词；C me宾格非所有关系。

questions.prompt: Please ____ before entering the closed room.
questions.explanation: C祈使knock原形；A单三、B分词不成指令。

questions.prompt: The baby is asleep. We speak ____ so she can keep resting.
questions.explanation: B quietly低声符合熟睡条件；A圆、C渴不表适合的说话方式。

questions.prompt: My friend gives me the cards. I thank ____. He made them himself.
questions.explanation: B thank后宾格him，后He明确人物；A物主、C主格不作宾语。

questions.prompt: There are three ____ for our paper game.
questions.explanation: A three需pieces标准复数；B单数，C错误复数。

questions.prompt: Can we use this table? Yes, you ____.
questions.explanation: C Can问用can答；A be、B do不对应许可情态问句。

questions.prompt: The cup is empty. Please put some water ____ it.
questions.explanation: A in杯内加水；B横过、C之前不表装入空间。

questions.prompt: ____ should we meet again? After lunch tomorrow.
questions.explanation: B After lunch tomorrow答时间When；A人物、C地点不符。

questions.prompt: Our visit is over. Which sentence thanks the host?
questions.explanation: C感谢招待；A门位、B借笔不表对主人感谢。

units.title: 在服务台等待老师的对话

materials.title: Lost Group Desk Order 038B
materials.text:
Order the dialogue. The first line is fixed: 1. I cannot find my class group.
A. Class Three, with Ms Fox.
B. Yes, you may. It is beside this desk.
C. I will call the teacher. Please wait here.
D. Thank you. May I sit on that chair?
E. Stay here. Which class are you with?
Choose the position from 2 to 6 for each line.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: B第3步回答Which class，给班和教师；A第2步先问，C第4步联系并留等，D第5步问坐椅，E第6步许可。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: E第6步Yes答坐椅许可并指出桌旁；A/B/C/D前四位置分别询班、答班、请等、问椅。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: C第4步有班师信息后联系并要求此等；A第2步尚问，B第3步答，D第5步问椅，E第6步许可。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: D第5步对留桌边等的安排致谢后求坐；A第2步先问班，B第3步答，C第4步请等，E第6步回应。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: A第2步先让留此再询班，为后续联系提供信息；B第3步才答班，C联系，D/E坐椅问答均在后。

units.title: 到达活动室时的五种状态

materials.title: Hall Arrival Adjective Bank 038B
materials.text:
Read the full passage and use each adjective once. Bank: A. heavy B. warm C. hungry D. dry E. empty
Noel has not eaten breakfast, so he feels ____1____ when we arrive. His water bottle has no water left; it is ____2____. A bag filled with thick books is ____3____ for one child to carry. We use a ____4____ towel, one with no water in it, to wipe the wet table. The heated room feels ____5____ after our walk through the cold wind.

questions.prompt: Which adjective completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: C hungry由未吃早餐支持；A heavy重、B warm暖、D dry干、E empty空均不描述这里需要食物的感受。

questions.prompt: Which adjective completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: E empty对应没有剩水；A heavy重、B warm暖、C hungry饿、D dry干不是本句水瓶内容空的直接描述。

questions.prompt: Which adjective completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: A heavy厚书满袋对一人搬困难；B warm暖、C hungry饿、D dry干、E empty空均不表达所述负荷。

questions.prompt: Which adjective completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: D dry由no water明确限定干毛巾；A重、B暖、C饿、E空均非本句干湿对比目标。

questions.prompt: Which adjective completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B warm与heated room和cold wind对照；A重、C饿、D干、E空不表到暖室的温度感受。

units.title: 五个许可问题要看具体条件

materials.title: Five Permission Replies 038B
materials.text:
Match each question with the reply that fits its actual subject. Use each reply once.
A. The photograph needs your friend’s permission first.
B. That box is heavy; ask an adult to help carry it.
C. The building opens at nine, so please wait until then.
D. Yes, you may borrow the model book if you return it on Friday.
E. The table is available after the current group finishes.

questions.prompt: May our group use the large work table now?
options: The photograph needs your friend’s permission first.
That box is heavy; ask an adult to help carry it.
The building opens at nine, so please wait until then.
Yes, you may borrow the model book if you return it on Friday.
The table is available after the current group finishes.
questions.explanation: E当前组用完后桌才可用，直接答桌条件；A照片、B重箱、C开楼时间、D借书条件不答该桌轮次。

questions.prompt: May I borrow this book of models?
options: The photograph needs your friend’s permission first.
That box is heavy; ask an adult to help carry it.
The building opens at nine, so please wait until then.
Yes, you may borrow the model book if you return it on Friday.
The table is available after the current group finishes.
questions.explanation: D书可借但周五还，答物品及条件；A照片、B箱、C开楼、E桌均非借该书。

questions.prompt: May I come into the building at eight?
options: The photograph needs your friend’s permission first.
That box is heavy; ask an adult to help carry it.
The building opens at nine, so please wait until then.
Yes, you may borrow the model book if you return it on Friday.
The table is available after the current group finishes.
questions.explanation: C九点开所以八点不能进；A照片、B箱、D借书、E桌条件不直接给楼开放时。

questions.prompt: May I include my friend’s photograph in the display?
options: The photograph needs your friend’s permission first.
That box is heavy; ask an adult to help carry it.
The building opens at nine, so please wait until then.
Yes, you may borrow the model book if you return it on Friday.
The table is available after the current group finishes.
questions.explanation: A照片需本人先同意，答使用许可；B重箱、C楼时、D书、E桌都不授权照片。

questions.prompt: May I take this very heavy box to the other room by myself?
options: The photograph needs your friend’s permission first.
That box is heavy; ask an adult to help carry it.
The building opens at nine, so please wait until then.
Yes, you may borrow the model book if you return it on Friday.
The table is available after the current group finishes.
questions.explanation: B重箱应求成人合搬，答独搬条件；A照片、C楼时、D书、E桌不处理重物能力。

units.title: 预报里的可能不是一定

materials.title: Forecast Possible Six Cloze 038B
materials.text:
Read the complete passage and choose a word for each numbered gap.
The weather note said rain was ____1____ during our class outing, but not guaranteed. Our teacher asked us not to replace that word with "____2____." We packed ____3____ to keep us dry if a shower came. An indoor room was kept ready ____4____ rain could change the plan. In the end, no rain fell. The spare room ____5____ available throughout the day. We wrote the result in our notes without claiming that the original message had ____6____ rain for certain. The teacher circled the word possible on our copy.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A possible与but not guaranteed相应；B木制、C饥饿不表天气发生可能性。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: C certain确定与possible不同，是教师说不能替换的词；A空、B圆不表达确定性。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: B raincoats遇雨保持干燥；A地图、C饼干不作穿戴防雨物。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B because下雨可能改计划解释备用室；A下面、C穿过不连接该原因从句。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: A remained available持续可用；B烹饪、C打印不表达房间保持开放状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C promised rain forcertain指保证雨落，原文否定该强读法；A称重、B种植不描述预报承诺。

units.title: 洞穴场景里需要哪一种蝙蝠

materials.title: Bat Prop Double Meaning Story 038B
materials.text:
For the class play, Theo saw a message that began, "Bring a bat for the cave scene." He read only the first three words and brought a wooden sports bat from home. At rehearsal, the class was preparing paper animals for a forest at night. Theo realised that his object did not fit the scene.
His friend showed him a simple outline of a bat with wings. They made the paper prop together. The teacher explained that both uses of the word were real, but the rest of the message showed which meaning was intended. Theo wrote "paper animal with wings" on the prop list. He kept the wooden bat for a game after school and carried the new paper bat carefully behind the curtain.

questions.prompt: What does Theo bring first?
options: A cave map from the teacher.
questions.explanation: B只读Bring a bat先带木制球棒；A活蝙蝠、C纸道具、D洞图不是初物。

questions.prompt: Which meaning does the full message require?
options: The sports equipment for a ball game.
The winged animal for a cave scene.
questions.explanation: D cave scene指夜间洞穴动物蝙蝠；A/B忽略情境，C bag不是bat。

questions.prompt: Why does the misunderstanding occur?
options: Theo ignores the later words giving the scene.
The teacher says the sports meaning does not exist.
The message contains no clue at all.
His friend hides the whole note.
questions.explanation: A只读前三词漏cave clue；B明确两词义真实，C有线索，D未藏。

questions.prompt: How is the needed prop made?
options: The class borrows a live animal.
Theo cuts the wooden bat into wings.
Theo and his friend make a paper animal from an outline.
questions.explanation: C看轮廓共制纸动物；A不借活体，B没割木棒，D未取消。

questions.prompt: What does Theo add to the prop list?
options: A description specifying a paper winged animal.
A promise never to use the word bat.
questions.explanation: C写paper animal with wings明确词义；A住址、B分数、D禁词都非行动。

units.title: 营地准备记录的词形

materials.title: Camp Preparation Word Forms 038B
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last night, we ____1____ (read) the camp plan together.
2. The cook put exactly two ripe ____2____ (tomato) beside the bowl.
3. The shaded room is ____3____ (cold) than the heated hall.
4. Look! A helper is ____4____ (open) the storage cupboard for the next group.
5. The leader waited ____5____ (patient; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly) while we checked our bags.

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use READ.
questions.explanation: 接受read：Last night需要过去式，read过去式拼写与原形相同；reads现在单三、reading分词、readed错误过去式不合。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use TOMATO.
questions.explanation: 接受tomatoes：exactly two明确复数，tomato常规复数加es；tomato单数、tomatoeses重复复数、tomato’s所有格不合数量任务，未列拼法复核。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use COLD.
questions.explanation: 接受colder：is与than明确比较；cold原级、coldest最高级、coldness名词不合比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use OPEN.
questions.explanation: 接受opening：is进行，open不双写n；open原形、openning错拼、opened过去式不表正在开柜。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from PATIENT.
questions.explanation: 接受patiently：本空明示PATIENT常规-ly副词。patient、patients、patience不满足本空形态约束，不概括其他英语语境合法性，未列复核。

units.title: 出游时表达不同的个人需要

materials.title: Different Outing Needs Functions 038B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves the stated purpose. Other options are reasonable outing questions with different goals.

questions.prompt: You need to avoid nuts and want the kitchen to confirm this dish’s ingredients. What should you ask?
options: Could you confirm whether this dish contains nuts?
questions.explanation: C具体核成分含坚果否；A加饭、B用餐时不提供目标成分信息。

questions.prompt: You cannot use stairs today and need a step-free way to the room. What should you ask?
options: Is there a step-free route to this room?
questions.explanation: A问无台阶路线对应通行需要；B结束时、C借笔不改变路线。

questions.prompt: The game is noisy, and you need a short quiet rest. What should you ask?
options: Is there a quiet place where I can rest for a few minutes?
questions.explanation: B短暂安静休息处直接满足；A分数、C买卡处不提供休息条件。

questions.prompt: A boat ride is optional, and you want to skip it while staying with the main visit. What should you ask?
options: May I skip the optional boat ride and still join the rest of the visit?
How many postcards are in the shop?
questions.explanation: B明确可选项目不参加及保留其余行程；A改全部、C明信片数非许可问题。

questions.prompt: Your phone battery is flat, and you want meeting details on paper. What should you ask?
options: Could I have the meeting details on paper, please?
Could we choose a different lunch?
questions.explanation: A请求纸面集合信息，符合已明示形式需求；B午餐、C照片作者不提供纸面细节。
